title: A begun turn whose session is gone has no end: no expiry closes it, and no other session can
outcome: A begun turn whose session is gone has no end: no expiry closes it, and no other session can
acceptance: Decided with the coordinator: a begun turn whose session will never return, such as one restored from a retired origin's store, gets a defined end. That end is either an attributed operator or recovering-session action that closes it with an audited record, or a stated policy that it stays open forever with its effects named. The behaviour is documented, and a test shows it.
